source: USGS 3DEP lidar, IA Eastern 2019 (public domain), via the usgs-lidar-public Entwine copy
note: x east, z south (game meters); length runs along the ridge (the long side, mostly), yaw is its direction counterclockwise from east (radians); height is the ridge's, eave the eaves' (the same for a flat roof); roof gable, flat or lean (one slope, up to the high side: +1 or -1 along the building's own z); roof_color the roof's in the 2015 aerial photo (tools/bake_aerial.py), if it was there
